title: Billing Desk Note: Professional Email Bundle Credit on Overdue Hosting Renewals
content:
**Billing desk note — Web Hosting Plans overdue renewals and Professional Email**

The overdue renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan is reduced by a mail bundle credit when a Harborline email subscription (Professional Email) in status active serves the plan's primary domain: USD 20.00 when that subscription has at least 5 seats, USD 10.00 when it has fewer than 5; a plan whose primary domain has no active Harborline email subscription receives no mail bundle credit.

**Seat count against the credit.**

| Active Professional Email subscription on the plan's primary domain | Mail bundle credit |
|---|---|
| 5 seats or more | USD 20.00 |
| 1 to 4 seats | USD 10.00 |
| none active | none |

**Points of judgement.**

- The subscription must serve the plan's own primary domain; a subscription on another domain does not count.
- Exactly 5 seats reaches the higher credit; 4 seats does not.
- The subscription's status must be active.
